assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road and rail redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, flood, heritage and existing-building surveys are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setbacks, detailed alignments, demolition and engineering feasibility remain unknown and require professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Overall and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometries derived from public text and announced areas.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers, ratios, dimensions and drawings must be recalculated after official polygons are issued.

assumptions.statement: Knowledge Ridge canopy segments, civic-space footprints, garden-laboratory width and phasing are participant design propositions for discussion.
assumptions.impact: They do not represent adopted planning, approved construction, funding or an implementation commitment.

assumptions.statement: The Future Academy Council, contribution archive and Jing-Zhang × Zhongguancun Open Futures Week are operating concepts.
assumptions.impact: Government, landowners, residents, operators, legal advisers and professional teams must develop any real arrangement.
